Messages.Author: Pepijn
Messages.Body:
When 2 minions you control both have a Servitor of Irad on them and a
Gehenna event is played, does that allow you to draw 4 cards, or
better to say 2 cards twice? I would say yes, since cards stack by
default and there is no relevant text I can find prohibiting this.

If yes do you need to draw 2 cards for the first servitor and discard
back to hand size before drawing another 2 cards and discard to hand
size? This would seem more logical to me then drawing 4 cards and then
discarding, allthough the latter would be even nicer ;)

thanx

Pepijn
